title: Generator Pipelines
prompt:
Build a text processing pipeline using generators in `solution.py`:

**Requirements:**
1. `read_lines(text)` -- yields non-empty stripped lines from a multiline string
2. `filter_comments(lines)` -- yields lines that do not start with `#`
3. `parse_ints(lines)` -- yields `int(line)` for each line
4. `pipeline(text)` -- chains all three generators and returns the sum

**Examples:**
```python
text = "# comment\n  10  \n20\n# another\n30"
pipeline(text)  # 60

list(read_lines("  hello \n\n world "))  # ["hello", "world"]
list(filter_comments(["# skip", "keep"]))  # ["keep"]
list(parse_ints(["1", "2", "3"]))         # [1, 2, 3]
```
hints: Each generator yields to the next stage
Generators are lazy -- data flows one item at a time
Chain by passing one generator as input to the next
sum() consumes the final generator and produces the result
